sections.title: Digital Media for Historic Preservation II
sections.description: A required praxis course designed for students to further explore the techniques and applications of digital media for visual and textual communication. Techniques will be discussed for preservation use including survey, documentation, relational databases, and digital imaging and modeling. Must enroll in both lecture and lab sections HSPV 6270-001 and HSPV 6270-101.
